steps.label: Ton tauschen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && [ "$(md5 -q m6c.tgz)" = b225642a54431e8af58c530b7aa7812e ] && mkdir -p m6c && tar xzf m6c.tgz -C m6c && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i out6.mp4 -i m6c/mix.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest peloton_film6c.mp4 && ls -la peloton_film6c.mp4
